Frequently asked questions

How many Registered Nurse jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 1,022 open Registered Nurse jobs in the United States as of November 26, 2026.

How much do Registered Nurse jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $39.75–$45.4 an hour, based on 11 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Registered Nurse jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include BAYADA Home Health Care (638 listings), Veterans Health Administration (281 listings), CLFC Healthcare and Communications (18 listings), 21st Century Home Health Services Inc. (14 listings), and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (11 listings).

Do I need a license?

RN roles require an active RN license valid in the state of practice. An NLC multistate license may apply in participating states. Confirm the listing and licensing board requirements.

Are there entry-level Registered Nurse jobs in the United States?

12 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.
